skill_name: Create a new recipe combining two different flavors.
workflow: Chocolate Banana Muffins: Start by preheating your oven to 350ᵒF and lining a muffin tin with paper liners. In a large bowl, combine 1 cup of all-purpose flour, 1/4 teaspoon baking powder and 1/4 teaspoon baking soda. In another bowl, combine 1/3 cup of softened butter, 1 egg, 1/3 cup of white sugar, 1/3 cup of brown sugar, 1 mashed banana and 1/2 teaspoon of vanilla extract.
